purpose: Check GPAI provider obligations under EU AI Act Art. 53 (technical documentation, training-data summary, copyright policy, model card, 4 base checks) and Art. 55 systemic-risk obligations (risk evaluation, adversarial testing, incident reporting, cybersecurity measures, 4 additional checks for systemic-risk models). Also scores voluntary Code of Practice sign-up. Returns base_score, systemic_score, overall_score, conformant flags, and gap lists. Feeds readiness diagnostic (art-176). GPAI enforcement Aug 2026. Zero network, zero PII.
